nom: Drunk Elephant Plump-C Tripeptide Lippe Mask

avis.texte: I got this as a gift and I can honestly and truthfully say thay my Burts Bees chapstick works significantly better. I frequently have chapped lips and I've been applying and reapplying this product for over a week now and have not seen even a slight improvement. When I went back to Burts Bees, my lips were fine in 2 days. Definitely don't waste your money on this product.
Leaves the lips soft and smooth and a bit plumper looking but I can't get over the texture. It feels like Vaseline.

avis.titre: Love this product, wish it was about 10$ less expensive.
avis.texte: This product has done all it promised and more. my lips are noticeably plumper, super hydrated, and very healthy. I love this product. I use it twice daily plus in between sometimes. In the evenings I really lather it on, above and below my lips even. Nothing else I've used comes close to these results. I do wish it wasn't so pricey. I was hesitant because of the price but I'm glad I went for it.

There's nothing special about this. I have been using it about 4 months as an overnight mask. If my lips are fine, it will maintain them overnight the same as any basic lip balm. I don't notice any difference with the ingredient claims. If my lips are mildly chapped before bed, this will not improve them. I have others that are cheaper that work better.
I use it every morning and right before bed. I love it. Already planning to order it again.
I used this for 2 weeks and it made my lips worse. I even used a lip scrub as well. it also smells and tastes terrible. I returned it.

This product is AMAZING. I was a bit hesitant at first, but now I'll use nothing else. My skin has gotten much drier in the last few years, so keeping moisture locked in is very important to me (I'm 61 years young!). It takes so little of this product to make a lasting impact. I put it on last thing at night, and my lips feel great the entire night. This is such a great addition to my Drunk lineup 🥰

⭐️⭐️ (at best) I really tried to like this lip mask. I'm doing a project pan and kept it on my nightstand to use day and night, so I gave it multiple chances. Unfortunately, it left my lips extremely dry every single time. Living through a New England winter, my lips already need extra hydration, so I kept reapplying hoping it would improve but it only made things worse. My last straw was when I applied it one final time and my lip actually split. I have never had dry, cracked lips like this before using this product. For a lip mask, this was shockingly drying and uncomfortable. I expected more out of this product.

This stuff is fabulous! It's not shiny, but very nourishing. My husband also loves it! I keep it in the living room and everyone who has tried it loves it! Highly recommend! It has lasted about a year with very regular use!

I wanted to love this product, but I do not. First of all, I didn't read the "how to use" before purchasing, so I thought it was more of a "lip mask" to repair overnight. I thought I would apply it at night and wake up to better lips. However, it's basically just the Lippe Balm in a different container, but more gloopy. Also after using it a few times, I actually thought my cracked lips were getting worse. I haven't used it in a week, and they feel better now.

avis.titre: Good but overpriced. Horrendous customer service
avis.texte: Moisturizes well but way over priced. Shipping and delivery took an eternity and customer service was non existent. I will NEVER order from this company again.

avis.titre: Gave my mother and I orange/yellow blisters on our lips.
avis.texte: Like any other lip mask my mom put it on her lips. I thought it was something else that made her have blisters on her lips until I just tried it this morning, took a nap and have woken up with a yellow/orange blister.
Great product though over priced. Won't be buying from this website again as shipping is shockingly slow and no customer service to speak of. Never agsin

Feels good upon application and hydrates temporarily. Unfortunately, my lips are crusted and sore the next day, more dry than beforehand. I've tried this in various situations but the end result is always the same. In general, Drunk Elephant products leave a lot to be desired and are not worth the price.
I just tried this for the first time and with this purchase. YES! l love it - thank you Drunk Elephant!!!
Drunk Elephant lip mask is thick and hydrating, perfect for winter winds that chap mylips.

avis.titre: Purchased for the "plumping".Not sure I would purchase again

I only rate it as good because it is. Good product but not as good as my favorite. I don't like the jar it is in. Small opening so I feel like I will be getting it under my fingernails to get to it once the top portion is used up.

Smooths lips, but leaves a bit of a coating. I recommend for use at night, not during day.
Last thing I apply - Lippe Mask to my lips. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Love products HATE the juvenile packaging

Honestly, this is just a more solid petroleum jelly. I expected it to be hydrating and plumping but I was very disappointed. I saw no difference in hydration or the plumpness of my lips. For its price, I expected so much more.

I think I've been spoiled with lip plumper having an effect of inflammation or something that is swelling your lips slightly and that's what I was expecting, so I was underwhelmed at first, but then really did feel like my lips were fuller on their own from consistent nightly use. Also cool with all of the drunk elephant products I've used. You don't have to wait forever to see results. It feels almost 1st time use you see it on your face.

avis.titre: Plan to keep this on hand at all times!
